test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing ‘1’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b7e6f85ebb9a5fa75168c435dd21bc27f5e43dc6a86250e484fc45fd350569e.png]
solution:
Taking dice Figure 1 and Figure 3 with 6 as common,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/351e61b56c9c8a2354c5652a4bb6bc9749f1eba3ef48efb0f083fe0256e4f8fd.png] 

Moving clockwise from the Common number 6,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91d3040b51536c92263e4b32f8bbab0473910e46705d525399d6205f71eb440a.png] 

Pair of opposite numbers:

1 - 6

3 - 4

5 - 2

So, the opposite number to 1 is 6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**.
